record.name: Epic MegaGrants
record.eligibility: Creators, developers, students and researchers doing notable work with Unreal Engine, 3D or the metaverse
record.funding_amount: Grants historically from about USD 5k to USD 500k, no cap stated
record.other_benefits: No obligation to use Epic products commercially; you keep everything you build
record.ip_conditions: You keep all your IP; no exclusivity
record.key_documents: Project description, portfolio, budget, how it advances the ecosystem
record.project_match: XR / spatial computing, immersive storytelling, Infinity Engine music-visuals, museums
record.why_relevant: Among the most founder-friendly creative grants: no equity, keep your IP, individuals eligible, up to substantial sums. Ideal for the Infinity Engine and immersive-media work.
record.risks: Should involve Unreal / 3D / real-time tech meaningfully; competitive at the top end
record.verify: Confirm the program is still accepting and current scope

pitch.project: Infinity Engine music-visuals pipeline / immersive storytelling
pitch.framing: A real-time, Unreal-powered pipeline turning music into immersive worlds for a local film community.
pitch.next_step: Package a demo reel and technical description, submit the rolling application.

rounds.reason: Official IRCC page requires a valid 2025 commitment certificate and application by 30 June 2026, and states that other applications are closed. The programme is paused.

record.name: Start-up Visa Program
record.status: Ongoing permanent-residency pathway (subject to annual caps)
record.opens: Rolling, subject to intake caps, verify at source
record.eligibility: Founders with a qualifying business supported by a designated VC, angel group or incubator
record.requires_local: Leads to Canadian permanent residency; requires a designated-organisation commitment
record.funding_amount: No direct government cash; the designated organisation may invest; PR is the core benefit
record.support_type: Residency pathway plus potential private investment
record.equity: Depends on the designated backer (often equity)
record.other_benefits: Permanent residency, strong AI research ecosystem (Toronto, Montreal, Vancouver)
record.ip_conditions: You keep your IP; investor terms vary
record.matching_required: Needs a Letter of Support from a designated organisation
record.key_documents: Letter of Support, business plan, language test, settlement funds
record.why_relevant: A rare startup route straight to permanent residency in a top AI-research country. Best if a long-term North American base appeals.
record.risks: Requires securing a designated backer first; capped intake; genuine relocation
record.verify: Confirm current cap status, designated-organisation list and processing times

pitch.framing: A research-driven AI company that fits Canada's AI-institute ecosystem.
pitch.next_step: Pitch a designated incubator or angel group for a Letter of Support.

record.name: National Geographic Society Grants
record.status: RFP-specific programme; current directory lists Trebek and Human Thread. October ocean calls are no longer listed; detailed closure evidence remains unresolved.
record.opens: Trebek portal opened 2026-09-01; other RFP opening dates not verified
record.closes: Trebek: 2026-10-28 at 23:59 ET (2026-10-29 at 13:59 Brisbane). Human Thread: 2026-12-01, exact time and timezone unverified. Ocean calls previously listed 2026-10-21 are no longer in the directory; detailed closure evidence unresolved.
record.eligibility: Individual project leader aged 18 or older; one proposal at a time and prior grant reporting complete. Project starts should be at least six months after submission deadline; additional RFP rules apply.
record.au_eligible: RFP-specific. Trebek does not require Canadian citizenship or permanent residency, though residency is preferred and distinctly Canadian impact is required. Human Thread nationality eligibility remains unverified.
record.requires_local: Individual project-leader grant route; any host, geography or fieldwork requirements must be checked in the selected RFP
record.stage: RFP-specific science, conservation, storytelling, education or technology project; accepted maturity not universally verified
record.funding_amount: RFP-specific. Trebek: up to CAD75,000, budget submitted in USD without exceeding the CAD cap. Human Thread amount unverified; no universal tiers assumed.
record.equity: Grant programme; detailed award and participation conditions not verified
record.other_benefits: Explorer community, connections, training and storytelling opportunities; specific entitlements vary
record.ip_conditions: RFP and award rights, publication, licensing and publicity terms not verified; no blanket founder-friendly guarantee
record.matching_required: Not verified for a selected RFP
record.key_documents: Project, budget and collaborator information through the Funding Portal; additional requirements are RFP-specific
record.project_match: Human Thread is a potential storytelling lead within approved cultural or immersive-media areas, subject to detailed RFP and permission checks
record.why_relevant: An individual-grant route for a precisely matched project. The Human Thread supports human-experience storytelling; the ocean calls concern specialist ship-based research and Trebek requires distinct Canadian impact.
record.risks: Human Thread and ocean detailed RFPs remain unreadable or inaccessible. No eligibility, cultural permissions or suitable portfolio assumed. Trebek requires distinctly Canadian impact; its deadline has not elapsed at this review. Directory disappearance alone does not establish closure.
record.verify: Review Human Thread detailed RFP for cutoff, amount, criteria, rights and budget rules; retain ocean closure uncertainty. Trebek award/IP terms remain unverified.

pitch.project: A community-led human-experience story within approved cultural or immersive-media work
pitch.framing: A specific story with an evidenced community relationship, consent and a suitable storytelling portfolio.
pitch.next_step: Review the Human Thread RFP before assessing fit or preparing a proposal; no account, application or cultural permission is assumed.

verification.notes: Official partner RFP and FAQ resolve Trebek cutoff, cap and conditional non-Canadian eligibility. Cutoff 29 October 03:59 UTC is future at this review (28 October 22:43 UTC).
